piece_type: DTC TV ad (“Road to Reduction XCOPRI DTC Commercial”)
regs_in_letter: FD&C Act (no CFR section cited in letter text)

cases.claim: [Omission] TV ad omits the Liver Injury warning and precaution; omits QT shortening from the MG “most important information” section. Ad includes: “Serious, life threatening allergic reactions or rash can occur, which may affect the liver, other organs, body parts, or blood cells, as can problems with the heart”
cases.context: DTC TV ad with efficacy claims.
cases.rationale: Completely omits Liver Injury W&P and omits material information on QT shortening; the included warning does not mitigate.
cases.check: Rule: diff risk content against PI W&P headings and MG 'most important information' items; flag any missing.

cases.cat: Major statement not in dual modality / incomplete major statement (TV)
cases.claim: [Omission] Hypersensitivity information included only in the SUPERs; audio omits telling HCP or getting emergency help for allergic-reaction symptoms and telling HCP right away about suicidal thoughts or actions
cases.context: Major statement SUPERs vs. audio do not match verbatim or by key terms; SUPERs include information not in audio.
cases.rationale: Fails to present major statement concurrently in audio and text (dual modality) and omits material information from the audio.
cases.check: Rule: align audio transcript with SUPER text during major statement; flag text-only or audio-only risk items and missing MG action statements.
